name: Unring The Bell
source:
A strange presence is terrorizing this house and it's your duty to stop it. Unfortunately, you don't know how to defeat it just yet. Speak to the presence and its victim to hear what they have to say, and look around the victim's room to pick up useful items. You must gather enough information about this demon to perform an exorcism, all while it tries to outsmart you.

[From [url=https://kirigayapnk.itch.io/unring-the-bell]itch.io[/url]]
